reason: I'm not letting an AI talk to my customers or touch my CRM on the strength of a landing page. At most I'd poke at the free plan with dummy data, but I'm not paying until I've seen it do real work without embarrassing me.
objection: It'll send something wrong to a client or mishandle customer data, and I'm the one liable under GDPR. 'Data access controlled by you' is a slogan; I don't know where the data is hosted, who the subprocessors are, or whether I can approve every message before it goes out.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own Google Workspace and CRM showing it finishes real tasks with approve-before-send on anything customer-facing, plus EU hosting and a signed DPA, and a reference from a Belgian or Dutch business my size.
